spec.prompt: Medium-wide shot, camera static at waist height, in the knee-deep red-brown shallows of a river in the late afternoon: a symmetrical face-off. The Lydian from reference image 1 (crested bronze helmet pushed up, braids, short beard, crimson tunic, bronze scale corselet, crimson lion shield), holding a spear, stands on the left in profile facing right; the Mede from reference image 2 (red felt cap, black curly beard, long-sleeved ochre tunic, iron scale corselet, wicker shield, short sword on his RIGHT thigh), holding a spear, stands on the right in profile facing left. Exactly centred and mirrored, full figures, shields up, spear points lowered toward each other, the gap between them in the middle of the frame; they step slowly sideways, circling, eyes locked, and do not strike. Behind them, across the water on a gravel bank, a raging battle fills the whole width of the frame from the very first frame: dozens of Lydians (crested bronze helmets, crimson tunics, lion shields) and Medes (red felt caps, ochre tunics, wicker shields) locked in combat in pairs and knots, spears thrusting, shields slamming, swords swung, men shoving, falling and getting up again, dust kicked up; it never pauses and nobody watches the two men in the water. Low golden sun at frame right, long shadows, warm rim light, clear air. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. No blood. Nobody sings or speaks; the audio is only background music for timing. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No stirrups, no flags, no modern objects. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: S25 v2: P15's mirrored face-off, now with the melee raging on the shore behind them.

Behind them, on the gravel bank across the water, the two lines fight from the first second: Lydians (crested helmets, crimson tunics, lion shields) and Medes (red caps, ochre tunics, wicker shields) clash all along the bank, spears thrusting, shields slamming, men falling, dust kicked up; the melee fills the whole width of the far bank. Camera static. Low golden sun at frame right, long shadows, clear air. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. No blood. No stirrups, no flags, no modern objects. No text, no watermark.
